notes.title: Rust Rides Launches Steam Workshop!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655805/0e8cb1c1a0550b2ed178faeefdf9f2f0ee663c61.png"][/img][/p][h1]🚀 [b]Rust Rides Launches Steam Workshop![/b][/h1][h3]Hello everyone following Rust Rides 💙💛
We have great news — we are starting the [b]"Let's Make the Game Together"[/b] flash mob.
Now each of you can create your own mods, builds, and even entire mod packs! We are officially adding [b]Steam Workshop[/b] support to the game.[/h3][hr][/hr][h3]✨ What you get at launch:[/h3][list][*][p]📦 Import your own 3D models (.gltf, .glb, .fbx, .obj)[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 Import textures (albedo, normals, alpha channel, emissive light maps)[/p][/*][*][p]🖼️ Built-in texture upscaler (256x256 → 1024x1024 in 1 click)[/p][/*][*][p]🔧 Presets for quick addition of interactive objects (for example, doors with their own model, texture, sound, and animation)[/p][/*][*][p]🚀 Tools for packing and uploading mods to the Workshop in a few clicks[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]We want Rust Rides to become one of the first Ukrainian games with Steam Workshop support.
Together with you, we can create new content and develop the game even further 🙌[/h3][hr][/hr][h3]💡 [b]Join the testing![/b][/h3][h3]
Today, on [b]Ukraine's Independence Day[/b], we are opening a registration form for the Steam Workshop beta test:
👉 [b][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1P-YgjIW0LitD1ohh2JcLq3BygIcfdwXyUTW4HqkbSck/edit"]Registration Form[/url][/b][/h3][hr][/hr][h3]🔥 [b]Add Rust Rides to your Wishlist[/b] to not miss the release and be among the first to get access to the workshop![/h3]

notes.title: Rust Rides: Development Never Stops
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Game development is in full swing. We're adding new cars, improving customization, implementing an inventory system, and preparing multiplayer. At the same time, we're working on graphics and optimization.[/p][p]We've also switched to a new engine — Unreal Engine 5.6.0, which will give us more opportunities to develop the project.[/p][p]Thank you for staying with us. Please share the game with your friends — it really helps![/p]

notes.title: Ukrainian Shield: Iraq — RTS
notes.notes: [p]Want to support the development of RustRides? Grab Ukrainian Shield: Iraq — a modern RTS about Ukraine’s peacekeeping operation in Iraq. Thank you for your support![/p][p]Tactical RTS set in the Iraq conflict. Command Ukrainian forces, launch airstrikes, capture positions. A dynamic and realistic strategy game.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3437180/Ukrainian_Shield_Iraq/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🔔 If you are interested - pay attention to us!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello, everyone![/b]
This isn’t a big update — more like a small wave to anyone passing by 👋[/h3][p]We’re already testing our game on Steam. Every day, we break things, fix things, add new stuff, and check old features. Just today, we tested P2P connectivity via Steam_Lobby. Yep, the game already connects through Steam and we’re steadily progressing![/p][p]This post is less about patch notes — more of a signal:
[b]If our game interests you, please wishlist it on Steam![/b] 💙
It really helps, especially before release.
And hey — if you tell your friends, or even make a TikTok with the hashtag #RustRides, we’d be thrilled.[/p][p]We truly believe our project deserves your attention. We’re putting both heart and tech brain 🧠 into this.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ A quick look at the technical side:[/h3][list][*][p]Solid [b]optimization[/b], even for weaker PCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Have an older GPU? We’re adding [b]AI frame generation[/b] for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Have RTX? Enjoy [b]full ray tracing support[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Don’t have RTX? No worries — it’ll still look great.[/p][/*][*][p]Our settings are flexible, adaptive, and designed for comfort.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]💬 Thanks for reading!
Be patient just a bit longer — we’ll deliver a [b]cool, stable, and stylish game[/b] just for you.[/p][p]With love,
The [i]Rust Rides[/i] Dev Team[/p]
